lines: Worlds too, by concept-rest, take that
unlit — suffering-state resting in bliss; but by
concept-decrease she shines indeed — thus this
l4.sanskrit_cite: lokās tu vikalpaviśrāntyā tām ahaṃtāmayīm ahaṃtācchāditedaṃbhāvavikalpaprasarāṃ nirvikalpāṃ vimarśabhuvam aprakāśitām iva manyante duḥkhāvasthāṃ sukhaviśrāntā iva vikalpanirhrāsena tu sā prakāśata eva iti iyam asau sambandhe grāhyagrāhakayoḥ sāvadhānatā iti abhinavaguptaguravaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What do worlds think about the uncontemplated? → The guru-perspective: ordinary worlds misread the avikalpā vimarśa-bhūmi as dark/suffering; vikalpa-decrease reveals it — sāvadhānatā is the method.
